summary: Day-by-day execution plan for launching Farrice's creative strategist practice on LinkedIn. Covers the first 14 days in exact detail: what to do each morning and afternoon, which copy to paste from which file, which workflows to run, which DMs to send, and what constitutes 'done' each day. Synthesizes all prior session artifacts (Cold Start Playbook, JCC Full Deploy, Profile Buildouts, Launch Posts) into a single operational document. Includes daily checklists, the exact sequence for profile setup, algorithm warm-up via comments, mini-brief production, and content publishing. Also provides the weekly review template and decision gates for when to escalate from comments-only to publishing mode.
